name: LAI-03 Process Legal Document
trigger: Copilot action or approved SharePoint library item created
actions: Verify current user and approved pilot Opportunity
Validate extension size data classification and required metadata
Invoke approved malware-scanning control when available
Store document in governed SharePoint library
Create DocumentReview row with Processing status
Run AI Builder or approved extraction action
Parse structured JSON using fixed schema
Calculate minimum field confidence and detect high-risk indicators
Store structured result model version prompt version and source citations
If confidence below threshold or risk present create human review task
Otherwise set Approved for pilot sampling policy
human_review: Reviewer compares every extracted field against source
Before and after values are written to AuditEvent
Final approval does not represent legal approval of the agreement
exceptions: Unreadable document: mark Failed and request replacement
AI timeout: retry twice then route to manual queue
Invalid JSON: preserve raw response in restricted diagnostic log and route to manual queue
